identity.name: research.search_ideas
identity.summary: From a Research Brief and the request's documents, form keyword queries, search the documents and the academic literature, and propose one to three candidate ideas, each citing the verbatim passages it rests on.

inputs.name: research_brief
inputs.description: The Brief: objective, scope and constraints steer the queries.

inputs.name: intake
inputs.description: The request and its documents, searched as the local scope.

outputs.name: idea_set
outputs.description: The queries, the evidence by query, and the candidate ideas.

external.purpose: run each query over the request's documents
run each query against arXiv and Semantic Scholar

checks.description: Every local chunk's source_id is an intake document_id and its text appears verbatim in that document; every external chunk's source has an http or https locator.
checks.author: muk

checks.description: There are one to three ideas, and two to five queries.
checks.author: muk

checks.description: Each query's group has chunks from at most TOP_K (5) external sources and at most TOP_K local documents.
checks.author: muk

checks.description: The value's canonical JSON is at most the policy's runner.max_inline_file_bytes, so the next model step can read it whole.
checks.author: muk

checks.description: On a test case, the queries and every idea's cited_chunk_ids equal the expected ones.
checks.author: muk

failure_modes.when: Every query found no local passage and no external source.
